326.reason: no keys: the package takes and generates no key material; operands are bits and bit vectors of the caller's width, not key bytes of a fixed strength

327.reason: bit arithmetic: package implements adders and an arithmetic logic unit over bit vectors only, no cipher, hash or MAC

407.reason: bounded work per call: a half or full adder is a fixed number of gate evaluations, a ripple-carry adder and every ALU operation make a constant number of passes over their operands, linear in the operand length, and the result is exactly as long as the operands (no width-driven allocation); no other input-dependent iteration
